name: Map Maker: Floors
note: Catalog of every floor piece of the game (generated by tools/make_map_maker_helper.py from the game data). The plane starts in the middle; the pieces are in rows, one tile each, with the name written on the floor in front of it, on a plain floor with walls all around. /room N jumps to a group of rows. Nothing ends this map: leave with /leave.

drawing.legend: . free floor, - no floor. First line = last sj row (the back). The walls are the edge walls of the floor (wallsOnEdges).
